accept.eula: I have read the Minecraft EULA and accept it for this server.
createFailed: The server could not be created.
hint.bindAddress: Host address the game ports are published on. 0.0.0.0: every interface. 127.0.0.1: this host only (players cannot reach it directly). Or one address of this host.
hint.containerName: Name of the Docker container. It is also the console's host name on the game network.
hint.dataDir: Host directory for this server's files. Must be below {{root}}.
hint.displayName: Shown everywhere in the dashboard. Empty: the game's name.
hint.key: Part of every address of this server: a-z, 0-9 and '-', 2–32 characters, no leading '-'. Cannot be changed later.
hint.ramMb: Hard memory limit of the container. 0 = no limit.
hint.rconPort: Reachable on the game network only; never published on the host.
noGames: No game is active on this installation yet.
problem.bindAddress: The bind address must be an IP address (for example 0.0.0.0 or 127.0.0.1), not a host name.
problem.image: Image and image tag are required.
problem.key: The key does not match the rule below its field.
problem.memory: Memory values must be whole numbers.
problem.port: Every port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
problem.rconPort: The console port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
problem.secret: This game needs a console password: a value or the name of an env variable.
problem.version: This game needs a game version.
secret.envHint: Name of a variable in the dashboard's .env; the value stays there and wins over a stored one.
secret.valueHint: Stored encrypted in the dashboard's database (key GSS_SECRET_KEY) and never shown again.
subtitle: The values come from the game's block in this repository. Check them, change what you need, create the server.
